title: Tile rows of the Mir Qavam al-Din Mar’ashi building, Amol
subtitle: Mir Qavam al-Din Mar’ashi building, Amol

given.O: The centre of a small square, at a half-turn point.
given.A: The midpoint of its right-hand side.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s IRAN16 drawing and its corners snapped to exact values. OA is half a small square’s side. The unit-square diagonal and compass transfers give the longer rectangular repeat. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The plain boundaries and four source fill classes are retained. The numeric palette is illustrative. No building photograph was checked. The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data197/IRAN16: Mir Qavam al-Din Mar’ashi building, Amol
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. Al-Naqsh, Design and execution of drawing in Iranian tilework, Islamic period (Reza Abbasi Museum, 1983), volume 2, page 176, Mir Qavam al-Din Mar’ashi, Amol. Also Bonner page 267, figure 140: Sultan Han, Kayseri (1232–6), and Esrefoglu Suleyman Bey, Beysehir (1296–7).

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. They make the square with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. They make the square with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre O through K1. It crosses the horizontal line through O at T, right of A. Draw a line through T at 90° to the line from O to K1. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Draw a circle with centre A and opening from O to K1. It crosses the horizontal line through O at S, right of A. Draw a vertical line through S. Turn it round O by 180°.

Draw a circle with centre A through O. It crosses the horizontal line through O again at E, right of A. Draw a circle with centre E and opening from O to K1. It crosses the horizontal line through O at U, right of E.

Draw a circle with centre U and opening OA. It crosses the horizontal line through O at W, right of U. Draw a circle with centre W, with the same opening. It crosses the horizontal line through O at Z, right of W.
Draw a circle with centre O through W. It crosses the vertical line through O at R, above O. Draw a horizontal line through R. Turn it round O by 180°.
Draw a line through each of U and Z at 90° to the line from O to K1. Turn the lines round O by 90°, three times.

Draw a circle with centre O through Z. It crosses the vertical line through O at V, above O. Draw a vertical line through U. Draw a horizontal line through V. Turn both lines round O by 180°. They cross at N1, N2, N3 and N4.
Join N1, N2, N3 and N4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange.

pattern.text: Put copies of the rectangular tile side by side.
